tools.description: Look up EPA eGRID electricity emission factors for a US ZIP code. tools.name: lookup_by_coordinates
tools.description: Look up emission factors by latitude/longitude. Uses US Census Geocoder to resolve to ZIP first, then returns the same data as lookup_emission_factor. Useful when you have a facility address or lat/lon but no ZIP.

tools.name: lookup_batch
tools.description: Look up emission factors for up to 100 ZIP codes in one call (split longer lists). Returns one compact row per ZIP - subregion, CO2e kg/kWh (location-based), residual mix (market-based), carbon-free %, utility - unless full is true, which returns every field (about 2 KB per ZIP).

tools.name: calculate_emissions
tools.description: Calculate Scope 2 CO2e for a facility from its ZIP and kWh, using both GHG Protocol methods: location-based (eGRID subregion rate) and market-based (Green-e residual mix applied to kWh not covered by RECs, PPAs or green tariffs). Returns kg CO2e for each method with the factors used.

tools.name: hourly_intensity
tools.description: Get hourly grid carbon intensity (kg CO2e per kWh) for any US ZIP code, derived from EIA-930 hourly fuel-mix data. Data lags up to about a day (not real-time). tools.name: plant_emissions
tools.description: Get emissions from EPA Clean Air Markets Division (CAMD) for a specific US power plant or a state: fossil units over 25 MW reporting to the Acid Rain Program and CSAPR. tools.name: electricity_rate
tools.description: Get the latest monthly average retail electricity rate ($/kWh and cents/kWh) for any US ZIP code, broken out by sector (residential, commercial, industrial, etc.). Data is state-level from EIA Form 861 - a ballpark, not utility- or ZIP-specific tariffs (use utility_tariff for those).
